title: Intertwining Defects and Fermion-Boundary Scattering from TQFT
summary: We construct conformal boundary conditions of free Dirac fermions that preserve chiral, anomaly-free symmetries, and determine the associated fermion-boundary scattering, using the TQFT/CFT framework. We apply the construction to several previously unresolved examples: higher-charge monopoles in non-chiral QED, a family of $SU(N)\times SU(N+2)$-symmetric models, the chiral QED with charges $\{1^5,3,(-2)^4\}$, and the charge-three monopole of the Standard Model.
